observations: warpMatchAny uses shared values in partial-lane participation; a block barrier substitution is unsafe.
Synchronization builtins are enabled unless HIP_DISABLE_WARP_SYNC_BUILTINS is defined.
Masked synchronization requires64-bit integral masks; implicit32-bit masks are intentionally rejected.
Unmasked synchronization uses wavefront release/acquire fences and a wave barrier when those builtins are invocable.
Mask checks bind the participating active lanes.
